last_episode_to_air.name: Happy Ending For The Kapoors
last_episode_to_air.overview: Bhagyashree performs her first Rasoi ritual while Gautam surprises Bhagyashree and Rishabh with tickets to Paris. Meanwhile, Revathi and Purab joyfully decide on the name of their soon-to-be-born child.

name: Bade Achhe Lagte Hain
overview: Bade Achhe Lagte Hain  is the sublime love story of an unexpected relationship. A marriage of compromise between two completely opposite personalities blossoms into a true partnership.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Ram Kapoor, a wealthy businessman, and Priya Sharma, a middle-class woman, who marry due to circumstances. Initially, their personalities clash, but as they navigate life together, they gradually fall in love.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: A modern love story of Ram and Priya, two individuals with contrasting personalities and beliefs about love, who are brought together in marriage.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: Ram and Priya navigating their relationship amidst new challenges and revelations. The season explores their evolving bond, highlighting their love story amidst a backdrop of family drama and personal growth.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: Bhagyashree & her struggles as a single independent woman who is afraid of love as she nurses her broken heart after a painful betrayal. She meets a free-spirited Rishabh who enters her life as a new hope of love. Could he be the one to heal her heart?
